metadata.title: Update on Dusty Sources and Candidate Young Stellar Objects in the S-cluster

notes: No eligible stars. The paper describes the dusty/G sources and S stars as orbiting Sgr A* on bound Keplerian trajectories (T:p1-b5, T:p6-b4) and does not identify any source as a Galactic unbound candidate or study any source because of such a previous identification.
